arabic text:
SEENA E SHABBIR PE QAATIL NE ZANU HAI RAKHA
KAAT TA HAI SAYEDE MAZLOOM KA SUKHA GALA
EK BAHAN SATAR QADAM SE KAISE DEKHE YEH JAFA
MAQTAL E SHABBIR ME GOONJI YEH ZAINAB KI SADA
english translation text:
The killer has placed his knee upon Shabbir's chest
and cuts the oppressed Sayyid's dry throat.
How can a sister watch this cruelty from seventy steps away?
Within Shabbir's battlefield, Zainab's cry echoed:

arabic text:
NA RAHE OWN O MUHAMMAD MERA AKBAR NA RAHA
NA RAHE QASIM MERA GHAZI DILAWAR NA RAHA
HAR SITAM KI HOGAYI HAI NANA ASGHER NA RAHA
IS SE PEHLE QATL HOJAYE YAHAN BHAYI MERA
english translation text:
Neither Aun nor Muhammad remains, nor my Akbar;
neither Qasim nor my valiant Ghazi remains.
Every calamity has reached its limit, Grandfather—even Asghar remains no more.
Before my brother is killed here...

arabic text:
SHAME ASHOORA HUWI AUR GHAM KE BADAL CHAGAYE
AAG LEKAR KHAIMA E SARWAR ME ZALIM AGAAYE
AAG THI CHARO TARAF EHLE HARAM JIS JAA GAYE
KARBALA KE DASHT ME SAADAAT KA THA MARSIA
english translation text:
The evening of Ashura arrived and clouds of grief gathered.
The oppressors came carrying fire towards Sarwar's tents.
Fire surrounded the sacred ladies wherever they went;
within Karbala's desert, the Sayyids' lament arose.

arabic text:
EK YATEEMA GHAM ZADA RUKHSAAR ZAKHMI HOGAYE
JALGAYA DAAMAN SAKINA KA TAMACHE HAIN LAGE
HAR TAMACHE PER TARAP KAR WOH SADA GHAZI KO DE
AUR BE BAZU DILAWAR NEHR SE KEHTA RAHA

HAR QADAM PER TAZIYANE AUR AABID NATAWAAN
BERIDAYI PER PHUPI KI KHOON AANKHON SE RAWAAN
BAAT KARNE ME HAI LUKNAT ITNI SUKHI HAI ZABAAN
HAD TO YEH HAI US SE YEH JUMLA NAHI HOTA ADA
english translation text:
At every step there were lashes, and Abid was frail.
Blood flowed from his eyes over his aunt's unveiled state.
His tongue was so dry that speech became difficult;
he could not even utter this sentence.

arabic text:
HO BAYAN KESEY KAREEM E CHASHM E NAM SALMAN E GHAM
SYEDA OR MURTAZA KI AAL PE THEY JO SITAM
SAKHTIAN SEHTEY RAHEY HAR IK QADAM AHL E HARAM
KARBALA TA SHAM YE KEH KAR CHALA HE QAFLA
english translation text:
O Karim, moist-eyed Salman, how can one describe
the oppression upon the children of the Sayyida and Murtaza?
The sacred family endured hardship at every step;
from Karbala to Shaam, the caravan travelled saying this.
